limitations: Three base cohorts only. All edge/interruption observations, native162 replay, finite12 and release qualification are outside this report.
One observation per directed case; no pooling of platforms, percentiles, variance estimate, performance threshold or controlled compression comparison.
Verified application/file bytes divided by whole installed-operation wall time; not network bandwidth, RTT, steady-state throughput, transfer-only speed or isolated command latency.
Wall clocks include the installed operation and local terminal/evidence collection; fixture setup and later receipt verification are outside that timer.
Stream numerator sums verified stdin/stdout/stderr; rsync and copy use verified file-content bytes, excluding protocol/MLS/Nostr/relay overhead.

Compression requests are source-defined asymmetric fixture settings. Copy validates a CLI-reported transport codec; no negotiated-codec/wire-byte measurement is inferred for stream or rsync; rsync -z was not requested.
No C2 observations are imported. C2 remains failed/not qualified with its historical failure preserved.
Raw source records are linked through admitted workflow artifacts and member hashes; identities, addresses, nonce/session/group/stream fields and private paths are intentionally omitted.
scope: Three base cohorts only; excludes all edge cohorts, interruption PUT/GET, native162 replay and finite12.
